skills.name: a11y-audit
skills.description: Audit UI against WCAG 2.2 A/AA — scan, fix, verify. Use when checking accessibility before handoff or release.

skills.name: architecture-tradeoffs
skills.description: Make and record engineering trade-offs before coding complex features. Use when choosing libraries, data models, or system boundaries.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review diffs for correctness, tests, security, and maintainability. Use after implementation before merge or handoff to QA.

skills.name: frontend-ui-implementation
skills.description: Implement responsive, accessible UI from a design system or mock. Use when building React/Next (or similar) screens to match design intent.

skills.name: project-status-risks
skills.description: Produce a clear status update with risks, owners, and next actions. Use for sprint or capstone coordination across agent roles.

skills.name: rapid-prototype
skills.description: Build the smallest demo that proves a riskiest assumption. Use for spikes, hackathon pace, or validating UX before production polish.

skills.name: reality-check
skills.description: Evidence-based readiness review — default to NEEDS WORK until proof exists. Use before calling a feature production-ready.

skills.name: sprint-prioritize
skills.description: Rank backlog items with RICE (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort). Use when choosing what ships this sprint or cutting scope.

skills.name: test-automation
skills.description: Plan and write automated tests (unit, integration, E2E) for the critical path. Use when adding coverage or scaffolding a test suite.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Write a failing test first, then minimal code to pass. Use for features and bug fixes (not throwaway prototypes).

skills.name: ui-design-system
skills.description: Define tokens, components, and handoff notes for a consistent UI. Use when creating or extending a visual system before building screens.

skills.name: user-stories
skills.description: Turn a PRD or problem into crisp user stories with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria and clear out-of-scope notes. Use when breaking work for engineering.

skills.name: ux-flows
skills.description: Map user journeys, information architecture, and critical path screens. Use when structuring product UX before visual polish.

skills.name: ux-research-synth
skills.description: Plan lightweight research and synthesize findings into decisions. Use when validating problems, flows, or designs with users or evidence.

skills.name: write-prd
skills.description: Write a short, evidence-gated PRD — problem, metrics, scope, and non-goals before engineering starts. Use when specifying a feature or initiative for handoff.
